length_limits.text: Computer Society policy sets the regular published length of a transactions paper at 12 formatted pages, including references and author biographies. The same page says submission page limits may differ and that each journal's own page-length policy should be checked. The TMC-specific author page did not load as text.

overlength.text: Pages or a fraction of a page over the 12-page transactions limit are charged US$220 per page after final editing and layout. This is independent of open-access or voluntary page charges. The page does not print a separate color-charge amount.
